configuration.changes: Independent F25 copy; change only weight BIND_STORAGE ram_2p to ram_s2p and sequential shift-register bias loading with constant destination indices. Preserve inference and all quantization boundaries.
configuration.conclusion: Use measured total LUT and outside LUT together; F27 is the ownership follow-up. Any selected variant requires fresh two-frame RTL and every supplied image.

estimates.basis: F25 measured 502 DSP, 73 BRAM18K, 37682 dataflow LUT plus 32294 outside LUT, 125404 FF and 1056904 cycles. Same MAC schedule gives 65025*16=1040400 compute cycles plus measured startup/load overhead. Budget roughly 15000 LUT savings from single-write/single-read bank ports and removal of dynamic bias writes; retain shared caller/process bank ownership and converter copies. No extra feature storage. The outside-LUT goal <=12000 is an acceptance target, not this conservative estimate.

configuration.interpretation: Compare parsed Total and dataflow LUT, Multiplexer LUT, loading modules, HLS200-1449 warnings, clock and cycles with F25. Explain deviations above20 percent. Failure to reach the loader-specific gate remains visible even if general numerical/resource gates pass.

configuration.purpose: WS2 control: isolate whether simple-dual-port runtime weight banks and constant-index bias shift loading remove top-level bank port multiplexers and dynamic register-write decoding. Keep the frozen F25 arithmetic, online replicate padding, two frames, AXI signature, T16 and 2.5ns clock. Expect identical output and three II1 folds; bank ownership remains shared, so the outside-LUT target may not be reached by this control alone.
